title: Schur-Riesz Variational Enrichment: A Generalized Refinement Framework for Finite Elements
summary: Width theory identifies economical spaces for compact PDE solution families, but does not provide a stable adaptive selection rule. We introduce Schur-Riesz refinement, which compares ordinary h/p refinement with operator-informed functions on a common variational scale. Projection removes content already represented by the incumbent, Riesz bounds test coefficient stability, and exact Schur gain ranks the surviving directions.
